subject: general
question: When was the first All India Postage Stamp issued?
solution:
• All India Postage Stamp issued on 1st October 1854.
 
• The stamp was known as ‘Half Anna Stamp’ which showed a youthful profile of Queen Victoria.
 
• That was the first stamp in Asia, issued by British India, which was decided to be printed in India in the interest of economy.
 
• After independence, India's first postal stamp was issued on 21 November 1947.
